# ADR-029 — Device-token auth scoped to device/notification endpoints; general API stays Tailscale-perimeter-only

**Status:** Locked

<!-- Decision text below is verbatim from the pre-split docs/DECISIONS.md table row (2026-09-16). Do not edit a Locked decision without explicit owner approval. -->

Device-token auth is scoped to device/notification endpoints. General API access remains Tailscale-perimeter-only; full lost-device revocation still requires tailnet removal
